Use this form to pause, cancel or change a membership. Please give it to the club within the notice period in your membership agreement. We will confirm everything in writing.
Is there anything we could have done better? (optional)
Direct debits continue until the end of the notice period in your membership agreement. The club will confirm in writing when the last payment will be taken.
A pause is agreed with the club and stops fees for the agreed dates. Fees restart automatically on the return date unless you tell us otherwise.
When a membership ends, the club stops using your SEPA mandate. You do not need to contact your bank.
